name: Tauya
confidence_why: One first-hand description, checked against the source; 1 other work consulted does not discuss stress.
catalog_quote: Primary stress falls on the final syllable in a word, with secondary stress on preceding alternate syllables. The initial syllable in a word is never without stress; if a word is polysyllabic, the initial syllable always receives secondary stress, even if this results in adjacent stressed syllables.

audit.action: a better source should be cited for the same classification

The 'contra' note against StressTyp2's clash-dropped profile is therefore sound.
